reels.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction

editorial_notes.reasoning: This addresses the 'context window' bottleneck, a major pain point for AI users. It fits the mechanistic interpretability multiplier and allows for elegant 3b1b-style animations of streaming data compaction.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI's short-term memory worked exactly like your own brain's 'active' workspace?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A frantic desk worker clearing off paper scraps into a filing cabinet to make room for new projects.
